visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a long grey wig and a grey blazer sits on a floor cluttered with wires, introducing himself as a professional organizer. (2) Cut to another man with glasses and a striped shirt sitting on a couch in a messy room, looking skeptical. (3) The organizer holds up a Buzz Lightyear toy box and drops it into a pink plastic bag labeled with black text; the room has storage boxes and a yellow poster behind. (4) The organizer holds a plush teddy bear; the resident man tries to stop him, but the bear is also bagged. (5) A person wearing a full black morphsuit and a white helmet stands motionless as the 'Iron Man' model; the organizer looks at it with disbelief. (6) The organizer pulls a pink plastic bag over the morphsuit person's head while the resident character looks on. (7) The resident man clutches his abdomen, showing physical discomfort and explaining his constipation through facial expressions and gestures. (8) Transition to a product showcase where a blue box labeled 'DERU' is presented against a bright background; various shots show the packaging and a jelly strip being held. (9) The man with glasses is shown consuming the jelly strip and then drinking water, looking relieved. (10) The man with glasses appears in a bright bathroom, smiling upward with a look of pure relief as natural light comes through a window. (11) A medium shot shows the man sitting on a toilet while the organizer stands at the door; they exchange dialogue about the outcome. (12) A man dressed as a character with half-black/half-white hair and a black cloak appears briefly at the door for a final reaction.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: The creator (male) plays multiple roles: the organizer, the resident, the morphsuit model, and a final character. Usually only two appear together in frames via editing.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character appears in two primary forms: an organizer with a long grey wig and a grey blazer, and a resident wearing black-rimmed glasses and a brown-and-white striped t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary scene is a cluttered living room with a cream sofa, various cardboard boxes, a yellow Crayon Shin-chan poster, and stray cables on the floor. Later scenes move to a brightly lit modern bathroom with white tiles and a white toilet.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a steady, rhythmic synthesized beat and fast-paced male dialogue delivered in a helpful but assertive tone. (2) Each time a visual cut marks a 'decluttering' action, a sharp 'impact' sound effect occurs, punctuated by the rustling of a plastic bag. (3) When the morphsuit character is discussed, the vocal pitch shifts between a defensive, high-arousal geeky tone and a skeptical, lower-pitched professional tone. (4) A loud 'whoosh' transition marks the shift to a higher-energy, promotional music track with bright synth textures. (5) The narration becomes extremely fast and enunciated, mirroring commercial broadcasting styles, while 'ding' sounds emphasize text pop-ups. (6) In the bathroom sequence, the music softens into a melodic, warm tone with the vocal delivery shifting to a sigh of relief. (7) The video concludes with a quick exchange of comedic dialogue followed by a sharp, cartoon-style final sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem -> Comedy -> Product Solution -> Relief
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Svelty (DERU) metabolism and digestion supplements by using a humorous skit about house decluttering that transitions into 'internal body decluttering' for relief from constipation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The second half of the video is a dedicated product pitch featuring packaging close-ups, usage demonstration, and benefit listing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production value social media ad using a popular creator's persona to make commercial content engaging through situational comedy.
